category: Self-hosted password and secrets management for organisations: a team password manager for people (personal vault, sharing, browser autofill, emergency access) combined with a write-without-read secret store, leases and a private certificate authority for applications, running inside the organisation's own Nextcloud with zero-knowledge encryption. A buyer, typically a Dutch public body wanting credentials kept on its own infrastructure, compares it with the SaaS team password managers (Bitwarden, 1Password, Keeper), the self-hosted open-source team manager Passbolt, the machine-secrets engine HashiCorp Vault for the application side, and the community Nextcloud Passwords app as the in-platform alternative. Decided from the code on 2026-09-26 (appinfo/info.xml, lib/Controller, 45 specs under openspec/specs); no prior competitor research exists for this product under any of its names.
